name: pixtool-next
description: Pixtool Next — online uzak sistem yönetim paneli (web + mobil + masaüstü)

scripts.setup:api: cd services/api && python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup:api:unix: cd services/api && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.build:bridge: cd services/bridge && ..\..\services\api\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m PyInstaller --onefile --name pixtool-bridge --console --noconfirm --hidden-import psutil pixtool_bridge.py
